notablePrerequisites: Fertilid has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
description:
Pay {1}{G} to Fertilid, searching your library for a basic Forest card, putting it onto the battlefield tapped.
Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping the land.
Retreat to Kazandu triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter Fertilid.
Tap the land for {1}{G}.
Repeat.
